source: scripts/build_params.py on 2026-11-17 from nflverse (CC-BY 4.0) via nflreadpy; 2021-2025 REG qualifying games (nflverse-data.md section 4)
carries_per_game_note: mean carries per qualifying game (WR/TE), for expected touches when there is no rushing market; QB/RB have no entry on purpose (see yards_per_carry)
yards_per_carry_note: pooled rushing yards / carries per position, to turn a rushing-yards mean into expected carries when there is no rush-attempts market (FanDuel has none)
qb_sacks_note: QB fumbles lost (S4.4) = qb_fumbles_lost_per_sack x expected sacks (qb_sacks_per_attempt x expected pass attempts, else qb_sacks_per_game) + qb_fumbles_lost_per_carry x expected carries; sacks_suffered and attempts from nflverse player_stats
td_share_note: per-player rushing TD share (ffp.td_share, nflverse-data.md section 6): v = (rho_rush*C + kappa*m) / (rho_rush*C + rho_rec*T + kappa), share = (R + k*v) / (N + k), with m = td_rushing_share, C/T/R/N = carries, targets, rushing TDs, rush+rec TDs over this season to date + prior_seasons previous seasons (REG+POST); rho = TDs per carry / per target in the qualifying games
